in Q3 steel shipments due to the impact on production caused by a turbine outage.

The Canadian steel producer guided for Q3 steel shipments of ~145K tons, compared to more than 419K tons in the year-earlier quarter, and adjusted EBITDA in the range of negative $10M to negative $20M, which included a $50M-$55M benefit of an expected capacity utilization adjustment.
The drop was caused by a turbine outage
at its Lake Superior Power generating facility in Ontario, the company said, but the turbine has since been replaced and is operating at full power.
"The LSP turbine outage temporarily constrained EAF production and was expected to affect shipment volumes," Algoma Steel
CFO Michael Moraca said. "Our third-quarter results reflect those impacts, including lower shipment volumes and a less favorable sales mix."
